description: Extends an existing Kling video clip up to three minutes total (Kling).

prompt.description: Positive text prompt for guiding the video extension.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

negative_prompt.description: Negative text prompt for elements to avoid. Empty → dropped from the wire body.

video_id.description: ID of the video to be extended. Cannot exceed 3 minutes total duration after extension.
